purpose: Turn Elementor JSON source evidence into reproducible WordPress/Elementor controlled-runtime evidence with source auditing, official Template Library import readback, widget inventory, semantic roundtrip comparison, direct preview rendering, cross-browser responsive checks and visual regression screenshots.

caller.qa_handoff: website-qa-checklist for staging/live/browser acceptance beyond this disposable controlled runtime

required_when: new or screenshot-reconstructed Elementor JSON needs a runtime or visual claim
existing Elementor JSON changes structure, widgets, widget settings, responsive behavior or dependencies
the user asks to test, scan, render, preview, screenshot, verify widgets, verify Pro or check import behavior
source-valid JSON is about to be described as runtime-valid or visually correct
optional_when: the task is a source-only audit or planning task and no runtime or visual claim is needed
forbidden_when: input contains secrets, credentials, personal data or client-confidential content while this repository is public
the task requires exact target-site IDs or target compatibility without target inventory or staging evidence
the task is a production or live-site mutation

runtime_pins.elementor_pro: must be explicitly supplied when Pro mode is enabled; never infer latest

before_run: read runtime-contract.json and verify repository, workflow, role and runtime pins
classify editor family, dependency mode, target objects and risk with the Elementor skill
sanitize public-repository inputs and keep secrets outside committed files
write or update canonical non-confidential test JSON under templates/
use target/inventory.json only when it is sanitized and controlled; otherwise use a private runtime
run: run source-level structural and dependency audit
start the pinned disposable WordPress/PHP runtime
install the pinned Elementor Core and Hello Elementor versions
optionally install an explicitly version-pinned Elementor Pro package with a GitHub Actions secret
import every template through Elementor's official wp elementor library import command
re-read the imported elementor_library data and compare it semantically with source JSON
render every valid template into an isolated Elementor Canvas preview page
run Chromium Firefox and WebKit browser checks at desktop tablet mobile and configured extra breakpoints
compare browser screenshots against committed visual baselines
upload audit reports import-roundtrip evidence runtime inventory render manifests Pro status screenshots and Playwright report
deactivate any temporary Pro license and destroy the runtime
readback: require Static JSON audit and Elementor runtime preview jobs to succeed
inspect source audit import-roundtrip reports runtime inventory render manifests Pro status and screenshots
keep target/staging tests separate from controlled-runtime evidence

inputs.target_inventory: target/inventory.json only when sanitized; private target data requires a private runtime
inputs.elementor_pro_version: ELEMENTOR_PRO_VERSION GitHub Actions variable/secret; required whenever Pro license secret is set
inputs.reference_visuals: committed only for sanitized public fixtures; confidential references stay outside this public repository

can_support: source structure checks including classic Atomic mixed repeater and reference warnings
runtime widget availability in the pinned disposable environment
successful Elementor Template Library import for tested templates
semantic equality after importer storage readback except generated element IDs
cross-browser responsive checks at configured viewports
visual regression against committed sanitized baselines
does_not_prove: site-specific object IDs or dynamic data correctness
real form email delivery or uploads
confidential target compatibility without a private target runtime

quality_gates.source: no structural errors; warnings remain explicit and may require target evidence
quality_gates.runtime: pinned environment starts, inventory validates, official import succeeds, semantic roundtrip passes and preview renders
quality_gates.browser: no page/console/request/resource errors, no horizontal overflow, no invalid nested interactive controls, keyboard focus sanity passes, reduced-motion mode renders, visual baseline matches
quality_gates.final: two separate identical green final workflow runs before a formal cleanup or 10/10 controlled-runtime claim

security.github_actions_permissions: final validation workflow must use contents: read only
security.dependency_policy: commit package-lock.json, use npm ci, run npm audit, maintain Dependabot configuration
security.action_policy: third-party GitHub Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs
security.branch_policy: main should require pull requests and successful QA checks; repository settings evidence is separate from this file
security.secret_handling: never commit secrets, licenses, private URLs, Composer auth, customer JSON or confidential screenshots
